deploybot: Deploy started — tag=release-v2.4.1 env=prod regions=[us,eu,apac] initiated_by=@Maria. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. dashboard: <https://deploy.redwood.example/ops/123> :rocket:

Maria: quick heads-up — we'll let us finish smoke first. if eu canary is flaky, hold there and don't proceed further.

Kai: seeing a small uptick in 5xxs on eu-canary after the schema migration, attaching quick dump.

Kai: ```json
{"service":"api","error":"timeout","p50":120,"p95":890}
```

Tanvi: looks like connection pool exhaustion. can we pin eu back to `release-v2.4.0` and continue us + apac? :thinking:

Chris: +1 to pin eu. enterprise customers route through that region, better to be conservative.

deploybot: Region update: us: SUCCESS — 3 nodes healthy — commit=abcd123 — finished=1840000301

Maria: confirmed us is green, traffic shifted back to primary.

deploybot: Region update: apac: IN_PROGRESS — 2/4 nodes drained — commit=abcd123 — probe=kv-warm

sre-bot: alert: eu-canary error-rate > 1% for last 5m. auto-hold applied.

Maria: pausing eu rollout, working on rollback/pin plan now.

Tanvi: I will open a hotfix PR to adjust pool config and propose pin. PR: <https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/987> sets `DB_MAX_CONN=200` for eu pool.

Chris: if we pin, we should add a note to the release notes and update the runbook with the rollback reason.

deploybot: Action taken: EU ROLLBACK PIN applied -> target=release-v2.4.0 initiated_by=Maria ts=1840000450

Maria: once the PR is merged I'll trigger a eu canary again against v2.4.0.

Kai: smoke test command to re-run after merge: `./scripts/smoke --region eu --tag release-v2.4.0`

Maria: timeline update: us ✅, apac ▶️ continues, eu ⏸ pinned to v2.4.0. will post completion when apac finishes and eu canary passes.
